text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I are doing a routine
check on
the comfort of her signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems somewhat distracted
throughout.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm a bit concerned, I focus my
attention on
our training schedule for
the next few days,
until...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I catch sight of Rice Shower outside the
window.
Confused, I rush out of my
office and chase after
her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"And then, the roses and all the visitors
in the
garden..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's reading a picture book out loud to
herself...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a book she's shown me before. Her beloved The Blue Rose of Good Fortune

text_block_list.text: I... can't stop thinking...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:

clothes... Do
I really deserve them?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The dress has a picture book
motif, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:

just once
more... Maybe I'd stop having
those thoughts.

show her.

"The blue rose began to wish it could
bloom
beautifully for everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:

unfolded, one by one, revealing its
beauty."

text_block_list.text:

grow.

text_block_list.text:

heart as I run!
